resourceList.description: Map of resource name (e.g. cpu, memory) to Kubernetes resource quantity.

periodSeconds.description: How often to perform the probe.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe is considered failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe is considered successful.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress.

host.description: Hostname to route through the Ingress.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress (secrets and hostnames).

image.description: Container image configuration for Uptime Kuma.

repository.description: Container image repository for Uptime Kuma.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

persistence.description: PersistentVolumeClaim for the Uptime Kuma data directory.

enabled.description: Enable a PersistentVolumeClaim for Uptime Kuma data.

size.description: PVC size, as a Kubernetes quantity (e.g. 4Gi).

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the PVC. Uses the cluster default when empty.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

replicaCount.description: Number of Uptime Kuma replicas. Keep at 1: Uptime Kuma uses a local SQLite database and does not support multiple instances.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod metadata.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context (capabilities, runAs*, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.).

port.description: Service port for the Uptime Kuma web UI.

ingress.description: Ingress for the main Uptime Kuma UI.

ingressStatus.description: Separate Ingress for a public read-only status page (paths should point to /status/).

resources.description: CPU/Memory resource requests/limits for the Uptime Kuma container. Left empty by default so it can run on resource-constrained environments.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for taints to schedule on matching nodes.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override chart name.

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override chart fullname.

imagePullSecrets.description: imagePullSecrets to use for pulling images (e.g. [{name: my-secret}]).
